items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: Helen is addressed by the interviewer and interviewee as a person being spoken to (e.g., 'as you know, Helen', 'Helen, would have become a fine writer'), but no personal relationship or interaction between Bud Freeman and Helen is described.

ctx.x: Yes. Dave, you know, had this extraordinary literary mind and as you know, Helen, would have become a fine writer if he had lived.
